shortDescription: Collect system activity report (SAR) data for system performance monitoring.

options.name: average
options.description: Whether to retrieve only the average values.

options.name: date_end
options.description: End date for collecting SAR data (format YYYY-MM-DD).

options.name: date_start
options.description: Start date for collecting SAR data (format YYYY-MM-DD).

options.name: partition
options.description: Whether to retrieve partition-specific disk statistics.

options.name: time_end
options.description: End time for collecting SAR data (format HH:MM:SS).

options.name: time_start
options.description: Start time for collecting SAR data (format HH:MM:SS).

options.name: type
options.description: Type of SAR data to retrieve.
